title: Brainscribe Corporate Website – 4-Page Static HTML5/CSS/JS

requirements.text: Create a shared HTML header component (included on all 4 pages) with a placeholder box displaying the text 'Brainscribe' in place of a logo, a navigation menu linking to Home, About Us, Services, and Contact Us pages, and a blue & white corporate color scheme. The header must be responsive.

quotes: Just a placeholder box
The header band should have a placeholder to the company logo
Please keep the theme should be blue and white

acceptanceCriteria: Header appears consistently on all 4 pages
Logo area is a styled placeholder box with the text 'Brainscribe'
Navigation links correctly route to all four pages
Header is responsive on mobile and desktop

requirements.text: Create a shared HTML footer component (included on all 4 pages) with company name 'Brainscribe', headquarter location (Pune, India), copyright year, and quick navigation links.

quotes: Pune is the headquarter

acceptanceCriteria: Footer appears on all 4 pages
Pune, India address is displayed
Copyright text and quick links are present

requirements.text: Create the Home Page (index.html) with the following sections: (1) Hero section with the Brainscribe tagline 'Engineering Intelligence. Empowering Growth.' and a brief mission statement; (2) Services overview section with icon cards for each service (Custom .NET/SharePoint/SQL development, Moodle LMS, Staffing, XDT, Azure/AWS Hosting, Instructional & Graphics Design); (3) Stats bar displaying '6+ Years in Business' and '50+ Projects Delivered'; (4) A brief 'Why Choose Us' section with 3–4 value propositions; (5) A call-to-action section linking to the Contact Us page.

quotes: 6 years in business, 50+ projects delivered
Please come up with a suitable Tagline and mission statement
The appearance should be of corporate website with lots of relevant images and infographics

acceptanceCriteria: Hero section displays the tagline and mission statement
All 6 service categories are shown as cards with icons
Stats bar shows '6+ Years in Business' and '50+ Projects Delivered'
CTA button links to contact.html
Page is fully responsive

requirements.text: Create the About Us Page (about.html) with the following sections: (1) Company introduction with mission statement and founding story (established 2019, headquartered in Pune); (2) Vision & Values section with 3–4 core values represented as icon cards; (3) Milestones / timeline section highlighting key company history points since 2019; (4) A 'Why Brainscribe' differentiation section.

quotes: The company was established in 2019
Pune is the headquarter
Do you have a tagline or mission statement for Brainscribe? - Please come up with a suitable Tagline and mission statement

acceptanceCriteria: Company founding year (2019) and Pune HQ are mentioned
Mission statement is present and coherent
Vision & Values section has at least 3 value cards
Timeline section reflects company history from 2019 onward
Page is fully responsive

requirements.text: Create the Services Page (services.html) with a dedicated section for each of the following 6 service areas, each containing a heading, descriptive content, and a relevant icon or inline SVG infographic: (1) Custom Application Development in Microsoft Technologies (.NET, SharePoint, SQL Server); (2) Moodle LMS Development, Customization & Integration; (3) IT Staffing Services across all technologies; (4) Offshore Extended Development Teams (XDT); (5) Hosting & Infrastructure Management using Azure and AWS; (6) Instructional Design & Graphics Design Services for eLearning.

quotes: For each service, create relevant sections and the suitable content
Development, Customization and Integration of Moodle LMS
Staffing Services across all IT technologies
Setting up offshore Extended Development Teams (XDT)
Hosting and Infrastructure Management Services using Azure and AWS
Instructional Design Services and Graphics Design Services for eLearning

acceptanceCriteria: All 6 service sections are present with unique headings and content
Each service section has an associated icon or visual element
Content is professional, relevant, and well-written
Page is fully responsive

requirements.text: Create the Contact Us Page (contact.html) with: (1) A HubSpot form placeholder section — a clearly marked div with a comment like '<!-- INSERT HUBSPOT FORM EMBED CODE HERE -->' and a visible placeholder box in the UI indicating where the form will appear; (2) Company contact information showing Pune, India as the headquarter address; (3) A brief introductory paragraph above the form placeholder. Do NOT implement a custom HTML contact form on this page. The page should be styled consistently with the rest of the site.

quotes: Create Contact Us page and later on I will insert the Hubspot form there
Pune is the headquarter

acceptanceCriteria: Page contains a clearly marked HubSpot embed placeholder div
The placeholder is visually distinct and labeled in the UI
Pune, India contact details are shown
No custom HTML form is present
Page is styled consistently with the rest of the site

requirements.text: Organize all image assets in a dedicated /images folder. Use relevant, high-quality placeholder images (via placeholder services or inline SVG illustrations) for hero banners, service section visuals, and about page visuals. Each image reference in HTML must use a relative path from the /images folder so that replacing image files is straightforward.

quotes: The images should be stored separately in the folder so that editing becomes easy

acceptanceCriteria: All tags reference paths under /images/
The /images folder is present in the project structure
Placeholder images or SVG illustrations are used for all visual sections

requirements.text: Create a .env file at the project root with configurable environment variable placeholders for: CONTACT_EMAIL (recipient email for form submissions), RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY, RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY, and SMTP_* credentials (host, port, username, password). Add a README.md explaining each variable and how to configure it. Note that the HubSpot form on Contact Us will eventually replace any direct email/form logic, but the .env is provided for future flexibility and completeness.

quotes: This should be configurable in .env file
The SMTP credentials and other environment variables related to reCAPTCHA are to be stored in .env file and should be configurable

acceptanceCriteria: .env file exists at project root with all listed variable placeholders
README.md documents each variable
No actual credentials are hardcoded in any HTML/JS file

requirements.text: Package all files (index.html, about.html, services.html, contact.html, /css, /js, /images, .env, README.md) as a downloadable ZIP archive and provide it as the final output.

quotes: The output should be a ZIP package of HTML5, CSS and JS

acceptanceCriteria: A ZIP file is generated containing all project files
Folder structure is clean and organized
All HTML pages open correctly when extracted and viewed in a browser

requirements.text: Apply a consistent blue and white corporate visual theme across all pages. Use a professional sans-serif typography system, a primary blue palette (e.g., navy/corporate blue #003366 or similar), white backgrounds, subtle grey accents, and clean section layouts with generous whitespace. The design should feel like a modern enterprise IT services company website — trustworthy, clean, and content-rich. Avoid dark themes, neon colors, and overly decorative elements.

quotes: Please keep the theme should be blue and white
The appearance should be of corporate website with lots of relevant images and infographics
No dark themes or bright colors

acceptanceCriteria: All pages use a consistent blue and white color palette
Typography is professional and legible
No dark backgrounds or bright/neon accent colors are used
Layout is clean, spacious, and corporate in appearance

constraints: Blue and white color theme only — no dark themes, no neon or bright colors
Contact Us page must use a HubSpot embed placeholder, not a custom HTML form
No PHP or server-side scripting — static HTML5/CSS/JS only
All images must be stored in and referenced from the /images folder
All configurable variables must be in the .env file — no hardcoded credentials
Do not mention the number of clients anywhere on the site
nonGoals: PHP-based backend or server-side email sending
Custom HTML contact form (HubSpot will be embedded later)
Dark mode or alternate color themes
Client count statistics or testimonials with client numbers
React or any JavaScript framework — plain HTML5/CSS/JS only
